# Keep a copied news URI independent from subscription account fallback

copyNewsgroupURL passes a server to constructNewsUriSpec only for an actual newsgroup folder; a standalone message therefore gets the serverless news: identifier form. The helper adds hostname and non-default port when a server is supplied and returns an empty string for an invalid URI. This copied identifier does not establish transport encryption. Subscription separately uses newsgroupServer, warns if absent and commits subscribe changes. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.

Scope: mail/base/content.
